snippet.title: 코요태레비전
snippet.description:

We are planning to show you lots of fun contents with 3 members of Koyote Kim Jongmin, Shin Ji and Bbaek Ga.
Please keep up with our channel, lots of love for Koyote and Koyotelevision. Thank you!
